The sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein **B0K928**, annotated as **3-phosphoshikimate 1-carboxyvinyltransferase** (also called EPSP synthase). The match is 100% identical across the full sequence, so this is an exact-sequence annotation rather than a function inferred from a more distant homolog.

**Catalyzed reaction:**

**Phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) + shikimate-3-phosphate → 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate (EPSP) + inorganic phosphate (Pi)**

The enzyme transfers the enolpyruvyl group from PEP to the 5-hydroxyl of shikimate-3-phosphate. It is **EC 2.5.1.19** (Rhea: **RHEA:21256**) and functions in the chorismate biosynthesis pathway.
